business: Juniper Environmental Group, Inc. (Environmental Remediation & Site Services)

expectedRedFlags: 'One-time' consulting and advisory: Unsupported and related-party. Level monthly payments across all 36 months to an entity affiliated with the seller's family.
Undisclosed related-party equipment rent: Disclosure failure, not an add-back. $216,000/yr of equipment rent is paid to an owner-affiliated entity and was not disclosed in the CIM.
Customer concentration: Largest customer, Quilcene Distribution, is 26.9% of FY2025 revenue; top 5 are 85.1%.
expectedYellowFlags: Seasonality and net working capital swing: FY2025 monthly EBITDA ranges from $51,040 to $194,086; cash ranges from $1,670,645 to $2,265,875. The NWC peg must be set on a 12-month average, not a period-end snapshot.
